name: Akanksha Foundation
mission: Works to transform the lives of children from low-income communities through quality education.

name: SNEHA (Society for Nutrition, Education and Health Action)
mission: Improves health and nutrition outcomes for women and children in urban slum communities.

name: Magic Bus India Foundation
mission: Guides children and young people out of poverty through structured livelihood and life-skills programs.

name: Goonj
mission: Converts urban surplus material — clothing, household goods — into resources for rural and low-income communities.

name: YUVA (Youth for Unity and Voluntary Action)
mission: Organizes slum and pavement-dwelling communities to secure housing rights and basic services.

name: Doorstep School
mission: Brings education to children at construction sites, railway platforms, and slum communities who cannot access formal school.
